name: Wizard tower interior
desc: the cluttered round workroom at the top of the stair, for study, bargains and long nights
tags: round tower room, curved stone wall, spiral staircase, crowded bookshelves, thick leather tomes, brass astrolabe, glass alembics and retorts, guttering candles, desk strewn with scrolls, narrow arched window
prose: the round interior of a wizard's tower, its curved stone wall lined with crowded bookshelves, a spiral stair climbing one side, a desk strewn with scrolls, a brass astrolabe and glass alembics among guttering candles, and one narrow arched window
note: Renders as an ordinary library unless the room is explicitly ROUND - the curved wall and the spiral stair are the entire tell that you are in a tower. Sparkles, glowing runes and floating objects are unreliable and often ruin the composition; get the magic from objects instead (astrolabe, alembics, tomes) and let the candles carry the light.

evidence_history.method: isolation clean plates (10 frames) survived library reject triage
